Title: uTPro SEO Audit
Description: Site-wide SEO & content audit for Umbraco (16, 17, 18). Crawls every Content & Media URL (plus sitemap.xml), checks for broken links, images and resources, and audits each page: SEO (title, meta description, canonical, H1-H3, noindex/nofollow, lang), Open Graph & Twitter cards, technical SEO (HTTPS, gzip, browser caching, schema.org, viewport, favicon), content quality (word count, readability, keyword density, thin & duplicate content), a static accessibility subset and estimated carbon emissions with an A-F rating. Get a per-run health score, a per-page composite SEO score (Lighthouse-style, 0-100), issues grouped by severity and priority, orphaned-page detection, incremental scans, CSV export and a per-page detail view - all inside the backoffice. Adds a per-node SEO Audit tab in the Content and Media editors that auto-audits on open. Runs as a recurring background job (auto-discovered by uTPro Job Monitor). Server-side and SSRF-safe. Built on the framework-agnostic T4VN.Seo.Core engine.
